title: The exact derived adjunction counit on a single complex
statement: Let A,B be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and K-injective resolutions. Let T:A→B and H:B→A be additive exact functors with adjunction a:T⊣H. Let h:RH(L[0])≅(HL)[0] be the canonical exact-H single comparison and t:D(T)((HL)[0])≅(THL)[0] the exact-T single comparison. For every L in B, D(T)(h⁻¹) followed by the counit of the canonical derived adjunction [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived] at L[0] equals t.hom followed by the single of the underived counit at L.

source.place: Tag 0AVW, lemma-affine-morphism, final pushforward identification; Tag 0AX3, remark-trace-map-finite

proof.text: Apply the derived counit factorization to the quotient of L[0]. The homotopy counit is the quotient of the termwise counit. Exactness identifies the right-derived unit of H with the inverse exact localization comparison.

Compose the termwise single comparisons with the termwise counit. At degree zero naturality of the object-identification maps identifies this with the underived counit; away from zero the source is zero. Apply Q and the defining formula for the single comparison, then cancel the exact localization comparisons. This gives exactly the stated identity.

theorem exact_derivedAdjunction_single_counit {T : A ⥤ B} {H : B ⥤ A}
    [T.Additive] [H.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (adj : T ⊣ H) (L : B) :
    T.mapDerivedCategory.map (H.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso.inv.app L) ≫
      adj.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction.counit.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).obj L) =
    (T.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app (H.obj L) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).map (adj.counit.app L)
